method: Built-in imagegen for six complete-character pose paintings. Pixel-preserving card-surface compositing uses the game's actual public/assets/cards/full/back.png, perspective matched beneath original fingertips. Whole drawings registered to consistent seated size.

prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Redraw Finn as TWO complete traditional animation key drawings, a matched pair on one landscape transparent canvas, two equally sized side-by-side panels. Reference image is the exact Finn character identity/style. Draw ALL anatomy together including head, neck, torso, arms, hands, legs and shoes, no cutout compositing, no separated parts. Slim youthful ADULT proportions, not baby or giant head. Orange wavy hair, fair skin, blue rolled-sleeve shirt, black loose tie, navy pants, yellow socks, brown shoes. Front-facing seated without chair. Rich flat sitcom cartoon, crisp outlines and coherent anatomy. The TWO figures have EXACTLY the same seated size, hip center, feet position and shoulder width; only pose changes. Generous transparent margins: complete character occupies 65-70 percent of each panel height, empty 15 percent above hair and below soles, empty 20 percent at the outer sides. No backdrop, lighting effects, chairs, table, labels, arrows, shadows, motion lines or grid. LEFT PANEL: Finn poised to play, image-LEFT hand holds ONE small black gold 100 card at chest, image-RIGHT hand holds the other card beside it, right fingers delicately gripping card edge, neutral focused face. RIGHT PANEL: throw wind-up, image-LEFT hand still retains its one card unchanged near chest, image-RIGHT elbow draws back slightly and right wrist cocks upward with the second card near shoulder height. Head and upper torso may turn a few degrees naturally together towards the right arm, subtle concentrated eyebrow expression. Neck connects smoothly to shoulders. No dramatic head tilt, huge expression change, broad shoulder inflation or extra cards. Cards use readable normal-facing '100' gold text, never mirrored. Both knees and shoes planted unchanged. This is an energetic short gesture towards the table IN FRONT of Finn, slightly image-right; NOT a sideways baseball throw. Each figure drawn coherently as a WHOLE character, with believable adult arm lengths, natural five-finger hands, and clean consistent source colors.

Use case: identity-preserve. TWO complete whole-character traditional animation key drawings for Finn, side by side on one transparent landscape image, matched scale and seating anchors. Image1 is Finn's identity master. Image2 is the preceding ready/wind-up pair and defines exact paint style, head size, outfit, anatomy and proportions for this continuation. Draw ALL anatomy together including the head and neck, no parts pasted in. Original front-facing slim adult seated Finn, copper hair, blue rolled sleeves, loose black tie, navy pants, yellow socks, brown shoes, NO CHAIR. Exactly same hip position, shoes and physical size in both equal panels. Generous empty transparent space around hair, fingertips and shoes; do not clip. No background/effects/table/labels/grid. Poses 3 and 4 of THROW. LEFT PANEL: forward acceleration from the previous wind-up. VIEWER-LEFT hand keeps ONE small black gold readable 100 card upright against chest. VIEWER-RIGHT forearm drives forward towards the table/camera, elbow bends naturally and sits beside torso, hand at LOWER CHEST LEVEL well ABOVE THE BELT, holding the other small card delicately by its edge. Natural mild whole head/neck/shoulder turn follows the action, brows focused. RIGHT PANEL: exact release beat, same forward right wrist and elbow location as left panel, but the right fingers have just opened and the thrown card is ABSENT. Open right fingers extended loosely, hand slightly ahead of chest with believable foreshortening. VIEWER-LEFT retained card and hand remain in the SAME place. Exactly one retained card total after release. No dropped/flying card drawn, no effects. Make the empty release hand almost exactly the same spatial position as the previous pinching hand, so the animated flying card can start here. Shoulder/tie/neck move coherently, no isolated stiff head or broken collar. Legs/shoes stationary. Five fingers, anatomically correct arms, crisp flat source cel drawing. No gigantic head, broadening torso, extra card, swapped working hand or upside down 100 text.

Use case: identity-preserve. Reference is Finn's approved complete cartoon character. Use case: identity-preserve. TWO complete Finn traditional animation key drawings side by side on true transparent landscape canvas, two equal panels, matched scale and pose anchors.
